name: Promenade (n.) - An Afternoon Walk in a Park -
source:
"On sunny days like these, it almost doesn’t matter where our steps take us."

A short story about two young women enjoying an afternoon walk in a park.

[Edited from [url=https://madeleine-chai.itch.io/promenade]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“在这样晴朗的日子里，脚步会带我们去哪里，似乎已经不那么重要了。”

一则关于两位年轻女子在午后结伴漫步公园的短篇故事。

[编译自[url=https://madeleine-chai.itch.io/promenade]Itch.io[/url]]
